function Dg(u) {

        detail: "the save header is incomplete"
    };
    if (i !== xu) return i > xu ? {
        ok: !1,

        detail: `the save was written by a newer build (schema ${i}, this build reads ${xu})`
    } : {
        ok: !1,
        reason: "past-version",
        detail: `the save uses schema ${i} and this build reads ${xu}`
    };
    if (!Mu(u.savedAtMs) || !Mu(u.idCounter)) return {
        ok: !1,
        reason: "malformed",
        detail: "the save header is incomplete"
    };
    if (u.idCounter < 0) return {
        ok: !1,
        reason: "malformed",
        detail: "the save header has a negative id counter"
    };

        ok: !1,
        reason: "malformed",
        detail: o
    } : {

            version: i,
            savedAtMs: u.savedAtMs,
            idCounter: u.idCounter,
            sim: u.sim
        }
    }
}

function sp(u, i, o) {

    const g = [];
    for (let v = 0; v < m.length; v += 1) {
        const b = m[v];

                f.set(D, O), O === 0 && m.push(D)
            }
        }
    }
    for (const v of u) g.includes(v) || g.push(v);
    return g
}

function hp(u, i) {

        if (U.kind === "entry") {
            U.currentRps = Ae, U.status = "nominal", U.cpuUtilization = 0, U.ramUsedGb = 0, U.latencyMs = 0, Co(U, Ae, V, q, O);
            continue
        }
        if (U.kind === "storage") {

            U.storageUsedGb = nn(U.storageUsedGb + _a, 0, U.storageGb), U.currentRps = 0, U.cpuUtilization = 0, U.ramUsedGb = 0, U.latencyMs = yh;

        }

        }

            U.storageUsedGb = nn(U.storageUsedGb + _a, 0, U.storageGb)
        }
        const Sa = U.kind === "database" ? ve * .85 : ve;
        Qe += U.kind === "server" ? ve : 0;
        const xa = Math.max(.04, 1 - cn),
            fi = yh + 1.4 / xa + ve / Math.max(1, U.capacityRps) * 2.2;

    }

U.status = "meltdown" : U.cpuUtilization >= 1 ? U.status = "critical" : U.repairSeconds > 0 ? U.status = "offline" : U.status === "meltdown" && (U.cpuUtilization = 0, U.status = "nominal")
    }

    for (const L of zt) {

        U.load = ve > 0 ? Eu(De / ve) : 0;
        const oe = le.latencyMs + ne.latencyMs;
        U.latencyMs = Number.isFinite(oe) ? oe : 1 / 0
    }
    const ke = {},
        Qt = [];
    for (const L of u.incidentOrder) {
        const U = u.incidents[L];
        if (!U) continue;
        const le = U.secondsRemaining - i;
        le <= 0 || (ke[L] = {
            ...U,
            secondsRemaining: le
        }, Qt.push(L))
    }
    const lt = u.difficulty === "easy" ? 36e4 : u.difficulty === "hard" ? 18e4 : 24e4,
        nt = u.difficulty === "easy" ? 18e4 : u.difficulty === "hard" ? 12e4 : 15e4;
    if (o >= lt && Qt.length === 0) {
        const L = u.elapsedMs >= lt ? Math.floor((u.elapsedMs - lt) / nt) : -1;
        if (Math.floor((o - lt) / nt) > L) {
            const le = [],
                ne = Object.values(O).find(Ne => Ne.kind === "storage" && Ne.storageGb > 0 && Ne.storageUsedGb / Math.max(1, Ne.storageGb) >= .5);
            ne && le.push({
                kind: "storage_threshold",
                nodeId: ne.id,
                title: "S3 storage threshold",
                detail: `${ne.name} is approaching capacity.`,
                severity: "medium",
                seconds: 15
            });
            const De = Object.values(O).find(Ne => Ne.kind === "entry");
            De && !De.shielded && le.push({
                kind: "ddos",
                nodeId: De.id,
                title: "DDoS attack",
                detail: `${De.name} is receiving hostile traffic.`,
                severity: "high",
                seconds: 20
            });
            const ve = Object.values(O).filter(Ne => Ne.kind === "server" || Ne.kind === "database");
            if (ve.length > 0) {
                const Ne = ve[Math.min(ve.length - 1, Math.floor(D() * ve.length))];
                Ne && le.push({
                    kind: "hardware_failure",
                    nodeId: Ne.id,
                    title: "Hardware failure",
                    detail: `${Ne.name} has failed and needs repair.`,
                    severity: "critical",
                    seconds: 10
                })
            }
            le.push({
                kind: "traffic_spike",
                nodeId: De?.id ?? null,
                title: "Traffic spike",
                detail: "Inbound demand jumped unexpectedly.",
                severity: "low",
                seconds: 10
            });
            const oe = le[Math.min(le.length - 1, Math.floor(D() * le.length))];
            if (oe) {
                if (oe.kind === "hardware_failure" && oe.nodeId) {
                    const at = O[oe.nodeId];
                    at && (at.repairSeconds = Math.max(at.repairSeconds, 15), at.status = "offline", at.currentRps = 0)
                }
                const Ne = {
                    id: zu("inc"),
                    kind: oe.kind,
                    nodeId: oe.nodeId,
                    title: oe.title,
                    detail: oe.detail,
                    startedAtMs: o,
                    secondsRemaining: oe.seconds,
                    severity: oe.severity,
                    acknowledged: !1
                };
                ke[Ne.id] = Ne, Qt.push(Ne.id)
            }
        }
    }
    const B = Object.values(O).reduce((L, U) => L + Ve[U.kind].hourlyUsd, 0) * (i / 3600);
    let w = u.economy.secondsToBill - i,
        he = te > 0 ? te : Ae,
        fe = u.economy.cashUsd,
        Ue = u.economy.accruedCostUsd + B,
        be = u.economy.pendingBill;
    const M = Qe * u.economy.revenuePerRpsUsd * i;
    if (fe += M - B, w <= 0) {
        w += _u, he = Ae;
        const L = u.elapsedMs - (_u - Math.max(0, w)) * 1e3;
        be = dp({
            ...u,
            elapsedMs: o,
            economy: {
                ...u.economy,
                cashUsd: fe
            }
        }, O, L, o, D)
    }
    let Q = !1,
        W = u.gameOverReason;
    return Q || (u.economy.billsPaid >= 10 ? (Q = !0, W = "mastered") : fe >= 25e3 && (Q = !0, W = "acquired")), {
        ...u,
        elapsedMs: o,
        nodes: O,
        nodeOrder: Y,
        edges: T,
        incidents: ke,
        incidentOrder: Qt,
        inboundRps: Ae,
        servedRps: Qe,
        droppedRps: Ut,
        gameOver: Q,
        gameOverReason: W,
        meltdownCount: u.meltdownCount + Wt,
        peakServedRps: Math.max(u.peakServedRps, Qe),
        economy: {
            ...u.economy,
            cashUsd: fe,
            totalRevenueUsd: u.economy.totalRevenueUsd + M,
            totalSpendUsd: u.economy.totalSpendUsd + B,
            accruedCostUsd: Ue,
            secondsToBill: w,
            cycleBaseInboundRps: he,
            pendingBill: be
        }
    }
}

function Co(u, i, o, f, m) {
    const g = f.get(u.id) ?? [];
    if (i <= 0 || g.length === 0 || !(u.kind === "entry" || u.kind === "loadbalancer" || u.kind === "server")) return;
    const b = i / g.length;
    for (const D of g) m[D] && o.set(D, (o.get(D) ?? 0) + b)
}
const vh = 50,
    Bo = 1500,
    yp = 64;

function qo(u) {
    return {
        lastTimestampMs: u,
        pendingMs: 0
    }
}

function vp(u, i, o, f) {
    const m = i - u.lastTimestampMs,
        g = m > 0 ? Math.min(m, Bo) : 0,
        v = f > 0 ? f : 0,
        b = v > 0 && m > Bo ? m - Bo : 0;
    let D = u.pendingMs + g * v,
        O = o,
        Y = 0;
    for (; D >= vh && Y < yp;) O = hp(O, Av), D -= vh, Y += 1;
    return {
        accumulator: {
            lastTimestampMs: i,
            pendingMs: D
        },
        sim: O,
        steps: Y,
        droppedMs: b
    }
}
const gp = 50;

                u = qo(performance.now());

            }

            u = b.accumulator, b.steps > 0 && Jo({
                ...v,
                sim: b.sim,
                revision: v.revision + 1
            })
        };
        let o = 0;

            i(), o = requestAnimationFrame(f)
        };

                u = qo(performance.now())
            };

        }
    }, [])
}
const Xh = "cluster-tycoon.highscore.v1",
    bp = 1e3,
    Sp = 10,
    xp = 1,
    _p = 200,
    Np = 50;

function Qh(u) {
    const i = Math.floor(u.elapsedMs / 1e3),
        o = u.incidentOrder.length,
        f = u.economy.billsPaid * bp + Math.round(u.peakServedRps) * Sp + i * xp - u.meltdownCount * _p - o * Np;
    return Math.max(0, f)
}

function tf(u = typeof localStorage < "u" ? localStorage : null) {
    if (!u) return 0;
    try {
        const i = u.getItem(Xh);
        if (i === null) return 0;
        const o = Number(i);
        return Number.isFinite(o) && o >= 0 ? Math.floor(o) : 0
    } catch {
        return 0
    }
}

function Mp(u, i = typeof localStorage < "u" ? localStorage : null) {
    const o = tf(i);
    if (u > o) {
        try {
            i?.setItem(Xh, String(u))
        } catch {}
        return u
    }
    return o
}

}

const Zh = ["loadbalancer", "server", "database", "storage"];

function wh(u) {
    return u.kind === "select" || u.kind === "connect" ? u.kind : Ve[u.kind].short

const zp = 30,
    Op = 1e3;

function Dp(u) {
    let i = 0;
    for (const o of u.nodeOrder) {
        const f = u.nodes[o];
        f && f.meltdownSeconds > 0 && (i += 1)
    }
    return {
        tool: wh(u.activeTool),
        placing: Zh.includes(u.activeTool.kind),
        paused: u.speed === 0,
        speed: u.speed,
        meltdown: i,
        incidentCount: u.incidentOrder.length,
        revenueMilestone: Math.floor(u.economy.totalRevenueUsd / Op),
        billsPaid: u.economy.billsPaid,
        invoiceBand: Math.ceil(u.economy.secondsToBill / zp),
        invoiceClock: Ml(u.economy.secondsToBill),
        revenueSpoken: Tu(u.economy.totalRevenueUsd),
        pendingBillId: u.economy.pendingBill?.id ?? null,
        pendingBillSpoken: u.economy.pendingBill === null ? null : Tu(u.economy.pendingBill.totalUsd),
        pendingBillAffordable: u.economy.pendingBill !== null && u.economy.cashUsd >= u.economy.pendingBill.totalUsd
    }
}

function Rp(u, i) {
    if (i.pendingBillId !== null && i.pendingBillId !== u.pendingBillId) {
        const o = i.pendingBillSpoken ?? "an unknown amount";
        return i.pendingBillAffordable ? `Invoice received. ${o} due. The simulation is held until you pay it.` : `Invoice received. ${o} due, and cash cannot cover it. The simulation is held.`
    }
    if (i.meltdown > u.meltdown) {
        const o = i.meltdown === 1 ? "node" : "nodes";
        return `Meltdown on ${i.meltdown} ${o}. Traffic is being shed.`
    }
    if (i.incidentCount > u.incidentCount) return "New infrastructure incident reported.";
    if (i.paused !== u.paused) return i.paused ? "Simulation paused." : i.speed > 1 ? `Simulation resumed at ${i.speed}x speed.` : "Simulation resumed.";
    if (i.billsPaid > u.billsPaid) {
        const o = i.billsPaid === 1 ? "bill" : "bills";
        return `Invoice settled. ${i.billsPaid} ${o} paid.`
    }
    return i.invoiceBand < u.invoiceBand && i.invoiceBand === 1 ? `Invoice due in ${i.invoiceClock}.` : i.revenueMilestone > u.revenueMilestone ? `Lifetime revenue ${i.revenueSpoken}.` : i.tool !== u.tool ? i.placing ? `Build tool ${i.tool}. Click the canvas to place it.` : `Build tool ${i.tool}. Not placing nodes.` : ""
}

function Cp(u, i) {
    return u.meltdown === 0 && i.meltdown > 0
}

function Lp(u, i, o) {
    return {
        x: (u.x - i.x) * i.zoom + o.w / 2,
        y: (u.y - i.y) * i.zoom + o.h / 2
    }
}

function ya(u, i, o) {
    return {
        x: (u.x - o.w / 2) / i.zoom + i.x,
        y: (u.y - o.h / 2) / i.zoom + i.y
    }
}

function Yp(u, i) {
    const o = i.w / 2 - u.x * u.zoom,
        f = i.h / 2 - u.y * u.zoom;
    return `translate(${Jt(o)} ${Jt(f)}) scale(${Jt(u.zoom,4)})`
}

function ph(u, i, o, f) {
    const m = Jh(u.zoom * f);
    if (m === u.zoom) return u;
    const g = ya(o, u, i),
        v = ya(o, {
            ...u,
            zoom: m
        }, i);
    return {
        x: u.x + (g.x - v.x),
        y: u.y + (g.y - v.y),
        zoom: m
    }
}

function bh(u, i = Kh) {
    return Math.round(u / i) * i
}

function Go(u, i = Kh) {
    return {

        y: bh(u.y, i)
    }

function $h(u) {

        x: u.pos.x - i.w / 2,
        y: u.pos.y - i.h / 2
    }
}

function Vp(u) {
    const i = tl(u.kind),
        o = Math.max(12, i.w * .12),
        f = Math.max(10, i.h * .2);
    return {
        x: u.pos.x - i.w / 2 - o,
        y: u.pos.y - i.h / 2 - f,
        w: i.w + o * 2,
        h: i.h + f * 2
    }
}

function Qo(u, i) {
    const o = tl(u.kind);
    return {
        x: u.pos.x + (i === "in" ? -o.w / 2 : o.w / 2),
        y: u.pos.y
    }
}

function Wh(u, i) {
    const o = i.x >= u.x ? 1 : -1,
        f = Math.max(40, Math.abs(i.x - u.x) * .55),
        m = {
            x: u.x + f * o,
            y: u.y
        },
        g = {
            x: i.x - f * o,
            y: i.y
        };
    return {
        d: `M ${Jt(u.x)} ${Jt(u.y)} C ${Jt(m.x)} ${Jt(m.y)}, ${Jt(g.x)} ${Jt(g.y)}, ${Jt(i.x)} ${Jt(i.y)}`,
        from: u,
        to: i,
        length: Math.hypot(i.x - u.x, i.y - u.y)
    }
}

function kp(u, i) {
    const o = i.pos.x >= u.pos.x;
    return Wh(Qo(u, o ? "out" : "in"), Qo(i, o ? "in" : "out"))
}

function Xp(u, i) {
    const o = i.x >= u.pos.x;
    return Wh(Qo(u, o ? "out" : "in"), {
        x: i.x,
        y: i.y
    })
}

function Qp(u, i, o = 96) {
    if (u.length === 0 || i.w === 0 || i.h === 0) return {
        camera: {
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            zoom: 1
        }
    };
    let f = 1 / 0,
        m = 1 / 0,
        g = -1 / 0,
        v = -1 / 0;
    for (const Y of u) {
        const T = tl(Y.kind);
        f = Math.min(f, Y.pos.x - T.w / 2), m = Math.min(m, Y.pos.y - T.h / 2), g = Math.max(g, Y.pos.x + T.w / 2), v = Math.max(v, Y.pos.y + T.h / 2)
    }
    const b = Math.max(1, g - f),
        D = Math.max(1, v - m),
        O = Jh(Math.min((i.w - o * 2) / b, (i.h - o * 2) / D, 1.4));
    return {
        camera: {
            x: (f + g) / 2,
            y: (m + v) / 2,
            zoom: O
        }
    }
}

function Pp(u, i, o, f) {
    if (!u) return i[0] ?? null;
    let m = null,
        g = 1 / 0;
    for (const v of i) {
        if (v.id === u.id) continue;
        const b = v.pos.x - u.pos.x,
            D = v.pos.y - u.pos.y,
            O = b * o + D * f;
        if (O <= 1) continue;
        const Y = Math.abs(b * f - D * o),
            T = O + Y * 2.2;
        T < g && (g = T, m = v)
    }
    return m
}

}

function sb(u) {
    const i = Ve[u.kind];
    return i.cpuCores === 0 ? 0 : Math.round(Math.log(u.cpuCores / i.cpuCores) / Math.log(i.upgradeFactor))
}

function ob(u) {
    return `$${u.toFixed(2)}`
}

function fb(u, i) {
    const o = u.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!o) return 0;
    const f = [i.title, ...i.keywords].join(" ").toLowerCase();
    let m = 0;
    for (const g of f)
        if (m < o.length && g === o[m] && (m += 1), m === o.length) break;
    return m !== o.length ? -1 : i.title.toLowerCase().startsWith(o) ? 3 : f.startsWith(o) ? 2 : 1
}

function rb(u, i) {
    return i.map(f => ({
        c: f,
        s: fb(u, f)
    })).filter(f => f.s >= 0).sort((f, m) => m.s - f.s || f.c.title.localeCompare(m.c.title)).map(f => f.c)
}

function db(u, i) {

                }]

                    }
                }]
            };
        case "tool:database":

                kind: "dispatch", commands: [{
                    type: "setTool",
                    tool: {
                        kind: "database"
                    }
                }]
            };
        case "tool:storage":
            return {
                kind: "dispatch", commands: [{
                    type: "setTool",
                    tool: {
                        kind: "storage"
                    }
                }]
            };
        case "node:scale": {
            const f = i.sim.selectedNodeId;
            return !o || !f ? null : {
                kind: "dispatch",
                commands: [{
                    type: "scaleVertical",
                    nodeId: f
                }]
            }
        }
        case "node:add-behind": {
            const f = i.sim.selectedNodeId;
            return !o || !f ? null : {
                kind: "dispatch",
                commands: [{
                    type: "addServerBehind",
                    nodeId: f
                }]
            }
        }
        case "node:decommission": {
            const f = i.sim.selectedNodeId;
            return !o || !f ? null : {
                kind: "dispatch",
                commands: [{
                    type: "deleteNode",
                    nodeId: f
                }]
            }
        }
        case "sim:pause":
            return {
                kind: "dispatch", commands: [{
                    type: "togglePause"
                }]
            };
        case "sim:speed":
            return {
                kind: "dispatch", commands: [{
                    type: "setSpeed",
                    speed: i.sim.speed === 2 ? 1 : 2
                }]
            };
        case "session:save":
            return {
                kind: "save"
            };
        case "session:manual":
            return {
                kind: "dispatch", commands: [{
                    type: "openManual"
                }]
            };
        case "session:settings":
            return {
                kind: "dispatch", commands: [{
                    type: "openSettings"
                }]

        case "session:menu":

                kind: "dispatch", commands: [{
                    type: "screen",
                    screen: "menu"
                }]
            };
        case "session:new":
            return {
                kind: "dispatch", commands: [{
                    type: "startNewCluster"
                }]
            };
        case "meta:close":
            return null;
        default:
            return null
    }
}
